backlog.title: v2.0 Current-Turn Scoping Delta (Draft 2.0)
backlog.description: Implement the single normative v2.0 design change: the agent may only modify context it produced in the CURRENT turn. Realized as: (1) mulligan_shrink targets current-turn-scoped with the by_content_includes arm removed and hard refusals for out-of-scope targets; (2) a filterPipeline turn-span scope guard (defense in depth, issuing-turn bound, persistence retained per the PRD §2 interpretation ruling); (3) Nudge B re-worded awareness-only; (4) mulligan_cancel two-arm lockstep with full-history marker resolution; (5) test-suite reconciliation (~46 by_content_includes occurrences); (6) changeset-level README sync. Spec/ is ALREADY at v2.0 — NO spec edits. Research is complete: see plan/008_1c8ca4d1826d/architecture/{system_context.md, scope_guard_design.md, external_deps.md, _scouts/*.md}.

subtasks.title: Enforce the span on both shrink paths (pinned identity + live selector; fail-safe no-op)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: the shrink pass loop is src/transforms.ts:1522-1547. PINNED path: resolvePinnedShrink(messages /*ORIGINAL space*/, branch, pinnedId) → origIdx; removedOrig.has(origIdx) → continue; binary-search ascending reducedToOrig to translate orig→reduced; applyShrinkAt(m, sh, reducedIdx). LIVE path: applyShrink(m, sh, branchEntries) re-resolves the selector against the reduced m (applyShrink at transforms.ts:963 calls resolveShrinkTarget at :986 — currently unbounded). The §2 RULING (binding): the bound is the MARKER'S ISSUING TURN, not the fire-time current turn — an in-span pinned shrink issued in turn N must KEEP applying after the user sends turn N+1 (persistence, cache rationale); the guard exists to no-op markers whose target predates the marker's own turn (malformed/legacy). See architecture/scope_guard_design.md §§1-2.
2. INPUT: markerTurnSpan + markerEntryId threading from P1.M1.T2.S1; 3-arg resolveShrinkTarget from P1.M1.T1.S2.
3. LOGIC: In filterPipeline's shrink loop, per marker: span = markerTurnSpan(messages, branch, markerEntryId); if span === null → continue (fail-safe no-op, E8-style silence). PINNED path: after origIdx resolves, additionally require origIdx ∈ [span.start, span.end) else continue (identity resolution is inherently scope-safe for well-formed markers; this no-ops malformed/legacy ones — pure defense in depth; KEEP the existing removedOrig + translation logic unchanged). LIVE path: resolve the selector WITH the span bound — recommended: thread an optional span into applyShrink (new 4th param span?) and pass it to resolveShrinkTarget, computing the span in ORIGINAL message space and translating/clamping into reduced space via reducedToOrig (conservative: if the span boundary cannot be translated, no-op — never WIDEN the span; a live selector must never re-target beyond its marker's turn, earlier or later). applyShrink substitution body, stampShrink/<context-shrunk>, and E25 render-only discipline: UNCHANGED. Mock nothing — pure tier.
4. OUTPUT: filterPipeline enforcing the issuing-turn bound on both paths; behavior surface for the critical persistence regression test (P1.M1.T3.S2). filter.ts stale-retirement pass (src/filter.ts:380-410) needs NO change — a permanently out-of-scope pinned marker now misses every fire and auto-retires via shrinkMissCounts (correct disposition; document in the wrap-up, do not special-case).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc on filterPipeline's shrink pass + applyShrink's new span param (cite spec/06 §5 v2.0: 'a marker whose target predates its turn no-ops at every fire'; PRD §2 ruling). Rides with the work.
